title: NotebookLM report import readiness audit
description: Audits manually exported or pasted NotebookLM report files before any RAG chunk import, source-ID mapping, or runtime retrieval promotion.
notes: This checkpoint scans report structure and coverage only.
It does not call NotebookLM, external providers, or runtime retrieval.
Reports can be complete enough for manual review while still requiring source-ID mapping before chunk import.
